title: Large media served without optimization
summary: Joomla templates or content fields serve oversized images or unoptimized media variants.
rationale: Oversized media increases bandwidth, client CPU/GPU work, and carbon impact.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Generate responsive variants, compress media, lazy-load below-the-fold content, and set cache headers.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
